sourceFacts.fact: Products, notes, tasks and completion history can be shared with invited household members; private user-entered content exists.

Manufacturer/product/manual links open through SwiftUI Link; user-provided task source URLs can also link to HTTPS destinations. No embedded general-purpose WebKit browser was identified in the inspected native source.
Invitation code is shared through the OS ShareLink. This alone does not decide the age questionnaire's messaging/content classification.
